fusions.name: Gong Shriek
fusions.desc: Strikes the shield's face. The sound deals 11 damage to everything in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sounding Ping
fusions.desc: Bounces a pulse of sound off the shield's face that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then echoes to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost in Shadow
fusions.desc: Hides you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice all of you 60% later, and the veil breaks for anyone who attacks.

fusions.name: Dusk Sentry
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%.
